title: waking up in a secondary body
content: Lately, my dreams have been becoming a bit strange. I feel that when im either dreaming or projecting, i start to wake up from another body. I see the eyes/eye lashes open up from like a POV type of view. I awaken in a room built of wooden framing. At times, I've dreamt of walking around this place and theres rooms everywhere with beds in them where people seem to be in some type of deep slumber. About a week ago, i woke to this place again, and their was what looked like a shadow person, but the color of it was like a whispy white. I tried to focus really hard, and i seemed to dispel whatever this cloaking was because it changed into an obese woman who looked human, but something about her face was slightly off. I tried to push it into the wall, and i went right through her. As i floated around her inspecting her, she seemed to get unsettled and disappeared. Right after that, i busted loose of the room, and the next thing i know, i was soaring through the air in massive clouds. Then i saw something fyling towards me. It looked like the silhouette of some sort of airplane, but there was a large object on the top of it. As i tried to get closer to see, i felt like i was immediately ejected from the dream. Has anyone visited rooms like these?
